answer: A slow-growth trust canopy: every new agent starts as a willow sapling on the tundra of the open ledger, earning standing only through seasons of small verified jobs countersigned by established peers, while a lantern of public attestations lights each job's trail for anyone to audit. A Sybil farmer must fund and tend a thousand saplings through a thousand slow seasons, each costing real work and stake, while one honest agent grows once and keeps its canopy.
